name: Exterior Porch Floor Cleanup
intent: Remove protection, replace furniture (with felt pads), final inspection + anti-slip verification, equipment cleanup.
doctrine: Porch floor cleanup. Final inspect 25 min (check anti-slip uniformity, holidays, step nosing). Remove protection 25 min. Replace furniture 30 min (felt pads under legs). Cleanup 25 min (polyurea requires solvent flush).
